changeSet.comment: Изменение поля card_type в таблице accounts-base для типа card
changeSet.sql: UPDATE accounts_base SET account_type = 'DEBIT_CARD' WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM accounts_card_debit WHERE accounts_card_debit.account_id = accounts_base.account_id );
UPDATE accounts_base SET account_type = 'CREDIT_CARD' WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM accounts_card_credit WHERE accounts_card_credit.account_id = accounts_base.account_id );
